The useful kind of overview

Less tab hopping.
More knowing what needs you.

UniHomelabDash starts as a genuinely useful service dashboard and grows into a safer control plane through focused provider integrations.

Calm by design

Power where it helps.
Guardrails where it matters.

⌂

One view

Everything important, together

Services, containers, health, hosts, and logs share one phone-friendly interface instead of a maze of admin tabs.
✓

Safe actions

Control without the cowboy mode

Provider actions are disabled by default, checked server-side, and confirmed against the exact container before they run.
◆

Private first

Your credentials stay behind the UI

Sessions use HTTP-only cookies and integration credentials are stored server-side with encrypted storage support.

Start simple. Grow with your lab.

Useful on day one.
Better with every contributor.

Run it with Docker Compose, add the services you already use, then connect Docker or Portainer when you are ready.
